topics.title: Speech School Outbursts
topics.summary: A man attends a bizarre speech school where the instructor uses increasingly inappropriate methods to improve diction, including repetitive 'birthday' drills and uncomfortable role-playing with offensive language and physical humor involving O.J. Simpson and Lester. The class includes chaotic interactions and attempts at trivia contests.

topics.title: Family Discussions & Disturbing News
topics.summary: Howard discusses Floyd’s sexuality with his son, leading to awkward conversations about Aunt May. Later, news reports detail the arrest of Joel Steinberg for plotting a child kidnapping and reveal disturbing details including looted items and abuse descriptions. Finally, they discuss Huey Newton's death following an investigation into drug use.

topics.title: Guests Disrupt Radio Station Lobby
topics.summary: During a radio show, Huey Newton’s widow and a West Point gynecologist create disruption by leaving messes in the lobby. The hosts express frustration over the mess while debating guest behavior and smoking/drinking policies on-site.

topics.title: Stern Trivia Show - Lobby Chaos
topics.summary: Howard Stern hosts a trivia game with Regina, Charlie and Keith in a messy lobby, focusing on memorable moments from his radio show history including al falling down a sewer and the infamous Scott Muni confrontation. The chaotic setting is highlighted as a source of frustration for Howard and his team.”}

topics.title: Radio Show Mishaps and Strange Stories
topics.summary: A chaotic radio show features a series of bizarre incidents including Steve-O’s story about winning on Wheel of Fortune, Jackie the joke man recounting his magazine appearance and water conservation idea, followed by reports regarding alleged sexual abuse at West Point involving a gynecologist and Rose Foster's testimony.

topics.title: Affair, Prison Calls, and Sex Education Changes
topics.summary: A woman’s six-month affair ends due to pregnancy refusal following alleged pressure from her husband; simultaneously, investigators trace calls made by a prisoner using aliases for money solicitation. Additionally, Nassau Community College altered its sex education course, removing detailed male genitalia slides but retaining explicit film footage.
